title: Android 原生库页面与 APK 对齐发布检查
summary: 包含 arm64 原生库的 APK 在发布路径中检查 16 KiB ZIP alignment 和 ELF LOAD segment alignment；不能因为上游构建宣称使用相应 flags 就省略对最终 APK 的验证。
assertions: Run zipalign verification with 16 KiB page compatibility against the produced APK.
Inspect every packaged arm64-v8a .so LOAD segment alignment.
Fail CI when any packaged native library violates the required alignment.
Run the check against the final packaged artifact, not only intermediate libraries.
